tagline.en: The world's first eSIM store with 200+ destinations
tagline.zh: 全球首家eSIM商店，覆盖200+目的地

description.en: Airalo is the world's leading eSIM marketplace, offering prepaid data plans for more than 200 countries and regions. Plans start from 1GB for 7 days, install in minutes via the iOS/Android app, and top-ups are instant. A solid default choice for most travelers.
description.zh: Airalo 是全球领先的eSIM商城，为200多个国家和地区提供预付费流量套餐。套餐从1GB/7天起，通过iOS/Android应用几分钟即可安装激活，续购即时生效。是大多数旅行者的稳妥之选。

details.en: Airalo's strength is consistency at scale: 200+ destinations with a uniform buying flow, an app that stores all your eSIMs in one place, and instant top-ups that add data to a running eSIM without reinstalling. Its catalogue splits into three tiers — local plans for a single country, regional plans (Asia, Europe, Africa and more) covering dozens of countries each, and a global plan usable almost everywhere — which makes it easy to pick the right scope. Verified pricing from the official storefront: a Japan eSIM runs US$4.50 for 1 GB / 7 days up to US$25.50 for 20 GB / 30 days, and the USA is similar (1 GB / 7 days from US$4.00, 20 GB / 30 days US$37.00). Airalo also runs Discover+ global multi-network plans and frequent seasonal discounts in the app. Support is 24/7 and genuinely multilingual, and the regional packages (e.g. shared data across 10+ Asian countries) remain the reference point that other providers' regional offers are compared against.
details.zh: Airalo 的强项在于规模化的一致性：200+ 目的地统一购买流程，App 集中管理所有 eSIM，续购即时生效且无需重装。套餐目录分三层——单国本地包、覆盖数十国的区域包（亚洲、欧洲、非洲等）以及几乎全球通用的全球包——选择范围一目了然。经官方商店核验的价格：日本 eSIM 从 1 GB / 7 天 4.50 美元到 20 GB / 30 天 25.50 美元，美国相近（1 GB / 7 天 4.00 美元起，20 GB / 30 天 37.00 美元）。App 内还有 Discover+ 全球多网络套餐与季节性折扣。客服 7×24 小时多语言在线；区域包（如 10+ 亚洲国家共享流量）是全行业区域套餐的比价基准。

bestFor.en: First-time eSIM users and multi-country itineraries — the safest default with the widest catalogue and the most predictable app experience.
bestFor.zh: 首次使用 eSIM 的用户与多国行程——目录最全、App 体验最可预期的稳妥默认选择。

en: Top up anytime without changing SIM

plansNote.en: Japan/USA single-country prices verified from airalo.com in August 2026. Regional and Discover+ pricing varies by promotion — check the app for live rates.
plansNote.zh: 日本/美国单国价格于 2026 年 8 月经 airalo.com 核验。区域包与 Discover+ 价格随促销浮动，以 App 内实时价为准。

en: Widest catalogue: 200+ destinations plus regional and global plans
Mature app: all eSIMs in one place, instant top-ups
Predictable quality — the benchmark other providers are measured against
zh: 目录最全：200+ 目的地加区域包与全球包
App 成熟：所有 eSIM 集中管理、续购即时生效
品质稳定可预期——行业比价基准

en: Rarely the absolute cheapest per GB — discount brands undercut it
Local plans are single-network in some countries, so coverage can dip indoors
No unlimited plans in most destinations (Japan/USA included)
zh: 单价很少是全场最低，低价品牌常能再压一档
部分目的地单国包为单网络，室内覆盖可能打折
多数目的地（含日本/美国）无不限量套餐
